rules: When budgeting, forecasting, controls, or financial-reporting detail needs controller review.
When people-process, compensation-operation, or performance-system detail needs people-operations review.

When a business decision needs legal or compliance risk triage and practical guardrails.

When the people-operations analysis, process recommendation, or organizational-health findings are complete.
